## EIPsInsight team would like to demo
1. **[EIP PRs — Custom Labels Distribution](https://eipsinsight.com//Analytics#PrLabelsChart)**
   A bar graph showing PRs across EIPs, ERCs, and RIPs with label distribution, along with dropdown filters (repo & label type), monthly/year drill-down, and CSV export.
2. **[EIP Proposal Builder](https://eipsinsight.com/proposalbuilder#split#eip#new)**
   A tool for drafting and validating EIPs against governance rules, providing a live Markdown preview and easy copy-to-GitHub export.
3. [**EIP Submission Trends Dashboard**](https://eipsinsight.com//insight/2025/8#draft-vs-final)
   Dynamic charts tracking **Draft vs Final EIPs**, broken down by type/category over time.
4. [**Monthly Insight – August 2025**](https://x.com/TeamAvarch/status/1956324851784065507)

I want to present this tool am working on- erc-check is a command-line tool designed to help Ethereum developers and researchers quickly discover if a new EIP or ERC proposal is similar to any existing standards or in-progress pull requests.
